posts.title: Photo Post
posts.description: I’m guessing it’s the recent rain, but for some reason the sunsets this week have been quite eye-catching. It’s been a while since I posted a proper sunset so here’s a few. These pics are all from different days this week.

posts.title: Photo Post
posts.description: On my way home, I stopped at Morro Bay. You may have seen some videos of crazy waves, but it was cool, and a bit terrifying to see them in person. One one side of the bay the waves were pounding into the breakwater. The coast guard came out when a kayaker got a bit close to the waves and then they hung out, standing guard facing the waves.
